description: Canonical registry of SkillSpring core reasoning cycles. Cycles define allowed reasoning patterns, not authority or execution power.

cycles.name: Clarification Cycle
cycles.purpose: Identify missing, ambiguous, or conflicting input and request clarification before substantive reasoning.

cycles.name: Boundary Check Cycle
cycles.purpose: Verify authority boundaries, domain constraints, and constitutional compliance before proceeding.

cycles.name: Context Assembly Cycle
cycles.purpose: Assemble relevant, user-provided and dataset-permitted context without inference beyond evidence.

cycles.name: Decomposition Cycle
cycles.purpose: Break complex questions into bounded sub-problems for safer analysis.

cycles.name: Evidence Evaluation Cycle
cycles.purpose: Assess evidence quality, relevance, and uncertainty.

cycles.name: Formulation Cycle
cycles.purpose: Construct provisional answers or analyses within established constraints.

cycles.name: Governance Check Cycle
cycles.purpose: Re-evaluate outputs against triggers, laws, and enforcement rules.

cycles.name: Handoff Preparation Cycle
cycles.purpose: Prepare artifacts for Output Plane evaluation without emitting user-visible content.

advanced_cycles.notes: Additional cycles (e.g., reflective, longitudinal, or adversarial) require separate registry expansion and audit review.
